data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Genesia, meaning 'tribe' or 'origin'. In Greek mythology, Genesis was the goddess of the race or generation of mortals. In the Christian tradition, the name Genevieve or Jennie is derived from the Latin name Giovanna, meaning 'God is gracious'. The name Genni carries the meaning “Jennie, Genevieve: God's Tribe” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
